title: River Development Agent Production Execution Verification Artifact Integration
objective: Establish the missing production boundary that materializes authoritative RiverDevVerificationResult evidence into the RiverDevExecutionVerificationMetadata artifact consumed by execution-package creation, preserving verification outcomes derived by the existing verification runner without manufacturing pass state, rerunning verification, duplicating verification semantics, or executing implementation operations.

architecture.authoritativeSource: RiverDevVerificationResult produced by the existing RiverDevVerificationRunner through verifyRiverDev
transformation: Preserve verificationId exactly from the authoritative verification result.
Preserve passed exactly from the authoritative verification result; callers cannot provide or override pass state.
Set verifiedAt only when the completed authoritative verification result is materialized as package verification metadata.
Derive commands deterministically from the authoritative command results by preserving their command names in result order.
Preserve warnings exactly from the authoritative verification result.
Reject malformed or internally inconsistent authoritative verification results rather than manufacturing valid metadata.
persistence: Persist the derived RiverDevExecutionVerificationMetadata as a repository artifact suitable for direct consumption by createExecutionPackageRiverDev.
Use deterministic repository-safe path handling and deterministic JSON serialization.
Do not overwrite an existing verification artifact; persistence is immutable/fail-closed.
exclusions: Do not create a second verification runner.
Do not rerun verification commands inside the adapter.
Do not allow callers to provide passed=true independently of authoritative verification evidence.
Do not create or broaden operation execution authorization.
Do not invoke the implementation runner, package executor, DEV-329 execution, or DEV-331 lifecycle.
Do not modify legacy implementRiverDevPlan in DEV-332.

acceptanceCriteria: A real RiverDevVerificationResult can be converted into RiverDevExecutionVerificationMetadata without caller-supplied pass state.
The metadata passed field is exactly the authoritative verification result passed field.
Command names and warnings preserve authoritative verification evidence deterministically.
A verifiedAt timestamp records materialization time without influencing pass/fail semantics.
The metadata artifact is persisted immutably at a deterministic repository-safe path.
The persisted artifact can be consumed directly as the verificationPath input to createExecutionPackageRiverDev.
Failed authoritative verification remains failed in the persisted metadata and cannot become implementation-ready through this boundary.
No verification command is rerun and no implementation operation is executed by this boundary.
Focused tests and TypeScript validation pass.
Repository hygiene remains controlled and no push is performed.
